mintAuthority.headline: Immutable Ethereum token with EOA EIP-712 minter, two-day role-grant delay, and issuer-gated ERC-3643 vault collateral.
mintAuthority.summary: SDLR is an immutable, non-proxy Ethereum TokenContract whose mint() path accepts EIP-712 signatures from a single EOA holding MINTER_ROLE, locking ERC-3643 SReserve collateral inside the registered VaultContract. Post-deployment role grants on both TokenContract and VaultContract enforce a 2-day (172,800s) ROLE_GRANT_DELAY, but single EOAs hold DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on both contracts, can immediately register vaults or whitelist collateral tokens, and control the upgradeable EIP-1822 SReserve supply with no independent reserve attestation.

sources.label: Verified SDLR TokenContract source on Blockscout

controls.label: SDLR MINTER_ROLE signer EOA
controls.capDescription: No hardcoded supply cap on TokenContract. Each mint requires a valid MINTER_ROLE EIP-712 signature and locks corresponding ERC-3643 SReserve collateral in the registered VaultContract; SReserve itself is an issuer-controlled EIP-1822 TREX proxy owned by 0x8d2d9a0db9aebd39a86f31ca902d46e3109e8bf4.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26506037 (2026-11-27T10:47:11Z, hash 0x53867165de3e65dd0b94c966bc5c30c80465dfdb0020c6c94de03a37b3c753ac), getRoleMemberCount(MINTER_ROLE) is 1 with sole member 0xe4041a4774007c0a2ecd070dcf0810270bf28b3c (eth_getCode = 0x, EOA). Verified TokenContract.mint() validates an EIP-712 signature from a MINTER_ROLE holder, calls VaultContract.lock(), increments lockedByVault, and mints SDLR with no numeric supply ceiling.

controls.label: SDLR TokenContract DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE EOA
controls.capDescription: Can queue MINTER_ROLE, BURNER_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE, or DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE grants subject to the hardcoded 2-day (172,800s) ROLE_GRANT_DELAY, and can immediately call registerVault, addToBlocklist, setTransferTax (up to 100 bps), and setTaxRecipient.
bypassSurfaces: registerVault(address) has no timelock delay; DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can register a new VaultContract immediately without waiting for ROLE_GRANT_DELAY.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26506037 (2026-11-27T10:47:11Z), getRoleMemberCount(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) is 1 with sole member 0x9178c5ec0248b2272a111e2cb51674664b19749d (eth_getCode = 0x, EOA). ROLE_GRANT_DELAY() returns 172800 seconds, enforced in grantRole()/executeRoleGrant(). Separate EOAs hold BURNER_ROLE (0x1d94b5cf6b4f073d0748911b64479060e47c684d) and PAUSER_ROLE (0xc2769b50d030cfde1db836e918836613a49e82fb).

controls.label: SDLR VaultContract (ERC-3643 collateral lock)
controls.capDescription: Immutable VaultContract holding 17,972.094165 troy oz of ERC-3643 SReserve (15,318.008958 troy oz locked against 476,443.336249 SDLR). Its DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE EOA (0x0ce7754ea0f48dca986117b0f3bc99284bad20cb) can immediately whitelist up to 15 ERC-3643 tokens and conversion rates via addWhitelistedToken.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26506037 (2026-11-27T10:47:11Z), VaultContract 0xac313bc5acdb47ae20c9bb77900f581d66bc3cd7 has EIP-1967 implementation slot 0x0 (immutable), registeredVaults=true on SDLR, lockedByVault=476,443.336249 SDLR (100% of totalSupply), ROLE_GRANT_DELAY=172800s, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE EOA 0x0ce7754ea0f48dca986117b0f3bc99284bad20cb, PAUSER_ROLE EOA 0x016a7011ca58414161a13755bf4c1ace9508f5b1, and agent 0xe18859ea6ec451fdca02edd60f95145b7f21e422. Whitelisted ERC-3643 SReserve (0x91f18b52d84bbce7ba0930cc2772399ce4adef72) is an EIP-1822 TREX proxy owned by 0x8d2d9a0db9aebd39a86f31ca902d46e3109e8bf4.

review.evidence: Pinned Ethereum RPC reads at block 26506037 (2026-11-27T10:47:11Z, hash 0x53867165de3e65dd0b94c966bc5c30c80465dfdb0020c6c94de03a37b3c753ac, https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com) and verified Blockscout Solidity v0.8.34 source establish that SDLR (0x0b57b7333c43fe900d17a81bddc67c88c825afd6, deployed block 25530195) and its VaultContract (0xac313bc5acdb47ae20c9bb77900f581d66bc3cd7, deployed block 25530196) are immutable non-proxy contracts (EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots zero). Both enforce a 2-day (172,800s) timelock on role grants. Issuance is controlled by single-EOA roles: MINTER_ROLE 0xe4041a4774007c0a2ecd070dcf0810270bf28b3c signs EIP-712 mints against ERC-3643 SReserve collateral locked in the vault, while SDLR DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE 0x9178c5ec0248b2272a111e2cb51674664b19749d and Vault DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE 0x0ce7754ea0f48dca986117b0f3bc99284bad20cb hold immediate vault-registration and token-whitelisting powers. On-chain proof-of-reserves reconciles ERC-20 supply against issuer-minted ERC-3643 balances only (internal-ledger), and no independent vault attestation or prudential licensing is disclosed for Lumina Secure S.A. (Panama).
